note: Canonical automation vocabulary. Two axes: actionKinds (what a step IS in any tool) and the moduleSkeleton stages (the SHAPE a workflow repeats). Every actionKind maps to exactly one skeleton stage. Lesson takeaway.realWorld.actionKind must be an id from actionKinds; takeaway.realWorld.bestFit[].tool must be an id from tools. Keep ASCII-only.

actionKinds.label: Trigger
actionKinds.gloss: something arrives, or a clock fires, and a run starts
actionKinds.cue: whenever work begins on its own - an email lands, a file drops, a timer hits - look for the trigger; if there is not one, the automation has not started yet

dialect.powerAutomate: 'When a new email arrives' / 'Recurrence' / 'When an item is created'
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a form submit, or a Copilot Studio topic trigger phrase
dialect.make: a Watch module, or a custom webhook
dialect.n8n: a Trigger node (Cron, Webhook, IMAP Email)
dialect.zapier: the Trigger step that starts the Zap
dialect.python: a scheduled entry point (cron, Task Scheduler) or a webhook route
dialect.langgraph: the graph entry point / START edge

actionKinds.label: Lookup
actionKinds.gloss: read the governed rule, reference table, or history the run needs
actionKinds.cue: when a number or rule is about to be hardcoded in a step, that is a lookup waiting to happen - move it out where it can be owned and changed

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Get items' from a SharePoint config list, or an Environment Variable
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Dataverse table read, or a Copilot Studio variable from a knowledge source
dialect.make: a Search / Get module against a data store
dialect.n8n: a database or Read node, or Workflow Static Data
dialect.zapier: a 'Find Record' search step, or Storage by Zapier
dialect.python: load a config file or query a table into a dict
dialect.langgraph: a retrieval tool call, or config read from graph state

actionKinds.label: Transform
actionKinds.gloss: parse, normalize, or compute so the data is safe to compare
actionKinds.cue: any time two values must be compared, ask what shape they are in first; comparison before normalization is where silent bugs live

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Compose', 'Select', 'Parse JSON', or an expression like float()
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Power Fx formula, or a Copilot Studio variable expression
dialect.make: an Iterator plus a Set variable / text parser module
dialect.n8n: a Set, Code, or Item Lists node
dialect.python: a parsing function; pandas.to_numeric or re.sub for cleaning
dialect.langgraph: a node function that rewrites state, or a structured-output extraction call

actionKinds.label: Condition
actionKinds.gloss: branch the run on a rule that someone owns
actionKinds.cue: when a person says 'it depends', that is a condition; write down what it depends on and who owns the threshold

dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Copilot Studio condition node, or an If() in Power Fx
dialect.make: a Router with filters on each route
dialect.zapier: Paths by Zapier, or a Filter step
dialect.python: an if/elif branch against the policy value
dialect.langgraph: a conditional edge routing on graph state

actionKinds.label: Approval
actionKinds.gloss: a person decides, and the reply is captured as a record
actionKinds.cue: if a human has to say yes, the automation is not done at 'sent' - it is done when the answer is stored

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Start and wait for an approval', then write the outcome
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: an approval card in a Copilot Studio topic, or a Power Apps review screen
dialect.make: a webhook-response pattern, or an approval-app module
dialect.n8n: a Wait node paired with a Form or Webhook resume
dialect.zapier: a delayed step plus a form submission that resumes the Zap
dialect.python: write a pending record and poll for the reply; never block on input
dialect.langgraph: a human-in-the-loop interrupt on the graph

actionKinds.label: Send
actionKinds.gloss: notify, route, or deliver to a person, queue, or channel
actionKinds.cue: a send with no recipient rule is a guess; the routing rule belongs in a lookup, not in the message

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Send an email (V2)', 'Post message in a chat', or 'Create item' in a queue list
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Copilot Studio message node, or a notification from the app
dialect.make: an Email / Slack / HTTP module on the route
dialect.n8n: a Send Email, Slack, or HTTP Request node
dialect.zapier: an action step to Gmail, Slack, or a webhook
dialect.python: smtplib or requests.post to the channel's API
dialect.langgraph: a tool node that emits the notification

actionKinds.label: Compose
actionKinds.gloss: assemble the deliverable from upstream artifacts
actionKinds.cue: a deliverable that restates facts instead of citing the artifacts that hold them cannot be traced back; assemble, do not retype

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Compose' plus 'Create HTML table', or a Word template action
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Copilot Studio adaptive card, or a Power Apps display screen
dialect.make: a Text Aggregator, or a Create Document module
dialect.n8n: a Merge node into an HTML or Markdown Set node
dialect.python: a Jinja template rendered from the artifact dicts
dialect.langgraph: a synthesis node that composes the final answer from state

actionKinds.label: Store
actionKinds.gloss: write it, retain it, and let it seed the next run
actionKinds.cue: if nobody can answer 'what did we do last time', the loop was never closed; retention is what makes tomorrow's run cheaper

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Create file' in SharePoint, or 'Add a new row' in Dataverse
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Dataverse write from the app or topic
dialect.make: a Google Drive / Data store module on the tail of the scenario
dialect.n8n: a database Insert node, or Write Binary File
dialect.zapier: a 'Create Record' action into Airtable, Sheets, or Storage
dialect.python: write the artifact to disk or a table with a run id
dialect.langgraph: a checkpointer write, or persisted thread state

actionKinds.label: Operate
actionKinds.gloss: connect it, trigger it, watch it fail, test it, promote it
actionKinds.cue: the workflow is one system and the automation running it is another; the second one also needs credentials, a schedule, a failure plan, and a test

dialect.powerAutomate: connections and connection references, run history, the flow checker, and solution export dev to test to prod
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: connectors and connection references, Test copilot, and managed-solution promotion
dialect.make: connections, the scenario execution history, and the Run once button
dialect.n8n: credentials, Executions list, pinned test data, and environment variables
dialect.zapier: app connections, Zap History, and the Zap test step
dialect.python: environment variables or a vault, structured logs, retries with backoff, and a test suite
dialect.langgraph: API keys per tool, LangSmith traces, and an evaluation run
